volumeOwnership.label: dev.sealant.mend.installation
volumeOwnership.identity: SHA-256 of the persisted identity.env bytes
volumeOwnership.policy: Setup claims the anchor before creating other volumes or starting Compose. Reject mismatched ownership and existing unclaimed Mend data; never replace credentials to adopt it. mend-garage is claimed the same way when the bundle carries Garage; a generation without it (an install from before the capture store) verifies without it. mend-vm-images and mend-vm-data are Compose's own volumes, not external: setup claims neither.

bootstrap.servicePrincipal: SEALANT_SERVICE_KEY configures the platform principal; Mend provisions each user through public @sealant/sdk users.ensure on first use
bootstrap.jobQueue: pg-boss inside sealant_control_plane (schema pgboss); created by the Sealant API/worker on first start

workspaceImages.note: Sealant builds workspace images through the mounted Docker socket and launches them from the same Engine by image id. No registry runs and no port is published for one. Each workspace is on a network of its own, from 10.233.0.0/16 (MEND_WORKSPACE_EGRESS_SUBNETS), where it reaches mend:3106 and garage:3900: sealant joins the mend and garage containers to every workspace network under those aliases. Workspaces never join mend_default.

derivedSecrets.note: Derived at render time from the identity, never stored in identity.env, so an installation's volume-ownership fingerprint is unchanged by the bucket's arrival.

captureStore.init: mend server setup/start run `garage layout assign`, `layout apply`, `bucket create mend`, `key import`, `bucket allow` through `docker compose exec -T garage`, idempotently, after `up --wait`
captureStore.sessionEndpoint: http://mend:3106 on the Compose network (not published)
captureStore.publicUrl: http://garage:3900 on the Compose network (not published)
captureStore.workspaceNetwork: a /28 network of each workspace's own, from 10.233.0.0/16 (SEALANT_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_EGRESS_SUBNETS); the Sealant 0.40.0-next.936 runtime joins mend and garage to each one under those aliases (SEALANT_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_MIRROR_CONTAINERS), never mend_default
